responsibility: This header defines the `cortexa57_tunings` model for Arm Cortex-A57 in the AArch64 backend. It introduces Cortex-A57-specific register-move and AdvSIMD vector cost tables and wraps them with issue-rate, fusion, alignment, approximation, and tuning-flag settings, giving the backend a dedicated microarchitectural cost model for instruction selection, vector costing, and scheduling decisions under Cortex-A57 tuning.
